clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family across the country to buy an apple orchard in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter's distance from June as he worked the trees from dark to dark, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's weeks in bed that first winter, Walter and June's rows over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir by September 1953 as things settled.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard failing in May 1968 when a late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter's heavy drinking that summer, Walter and Glen's blame of each other over the loan, Glen and Marian's takeover of the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worse that winter, Nora's bedwetting in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found in May 1969, and Walter's stop to drinking and turn to pruning work by October 1969 as things settled.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within sixteen months: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck in the yard, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian's second job cleaning offices at night, Nora's weight loss and stopped eating properly that summer, Nora's distance from her mother and time in her room, Walter's return to drinking after six years off it by December 1975, and Nora's eating again and making the track team by June 1976 as things settled.

clusters.name: Wilma moved into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Sam's mother Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Sam's house in January 1990, within seventeen months: Nora's clashes with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Sam's distance from the kitchen rows and work kept late, Sam's move toward his mother's side, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma's takeover of Lily's care, Nora's eczema flared on both hands, Nora and Sam's rows most nights by November 1990, and Wilma's move to a flat in town by June 1991 with Nora's eczema clearing over the summer as things settled.

declined.reason: Four days in August 1994, from the wildfire over the ridge to the family allowed home three nights later, everyone calm again once home within the week: an acute episode around a real threat, not a period.

Around Tess's drinking in October 1996 within three months: Tess's drinking most nights, Nora's worry and phone calls every night, and Tess's move to stop drinking and go to meetings by June 1997. Tess is Nora's sister but this is Tess's own trouble; every shift in these months is Tess's or Nora's response to Tess, and no one else's shifts show then, so there is not enough in the diagram to choose a reading of a broader family process.
